title: Species Progression and Maturation Hooks
objective: Permit optional species progression, maturation and unlock trees through the existing progression-event model without creating a species-specific progression engine.
boundaries: MVPS-10 owns species-facing progression and maturation hooks only; generic progression/Event execution remains with shared owners.
Species progression is optional and may not be assumed for every species.
Unlocks and maturation changes must be attributable to explicit Event/progression records and preserve provenance.
Duplicate or overlapping grants defer to shared stacking/replacement rules rather than species-local logic.
Forms/transformation semantics remain MVPS-09; runtime active-contribution projection/receipts remain MVPS-13.
MVPS-11+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.
